profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer | Secret Clearance | HTML | CSS | JavaScript | SQL | ReactJS | Python | Java | C# | .NET
profile.summary:
I am passionate about learning new technologies and staying updated on the latest trends and best practices in the industry. I have gained proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, React, .NET, C#, SQL, Python, and Java, and I am always eager to expand my knowledge and skills. I also value collaboration, quality, and attention to detail, which I developed through my military background and my previous roles as a web developer and a program coordinator. My goal is to deliver innovative, user-friendly, and secure web solutions that meet the needs and expectations of my clients and users.

Whenever I'm not glued to a computer you can usually find me out making new memories with the people I love the most. I enjoy traveling, trying new foods, listening to music and also DIY home projects.

positions.title: Transportation Management Coordinator
positions.description:
- Performed system administrator duties such as installing software and uploading
data to computer systems.

- Documented and inventoried freight, cargo and material shipments of all types.

- Assisted the platoon sergeant with planning, coordinating and supervising all tasks that the squad was assigned to accomplish.

- Supervised individual and squad level training and mentored subordinates to ensure
they were properly prepared.

- Provided leadership, direction, and training to soldiers; developed soldiers for positions
of increased responsibility by counseling, mentoring and job shadowing.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Partnered with other members of the IT team to develop custom solutions for stakeholders and potential clients

- Created user interfaces using HTML, CSS, jQuery, and JavaScript.

- Developed user interface elements, such as menus, tabs, and widgets.

- Participated in quality assurance and user testing activities.

- Collaborated with an agile development team and conducted
daily standups.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Trainsquare is an online platform used to post and find workshops of interest within your community that host in-person, hands-on interactive group events.

- Designed tables and stored procedures in MS SQL Server.
Utilized Joins to simplify queries involving multiple tables.

- Resolved database issues by debugging/troubleshooting
stored procedures.

- Developed RESTful API controllers and services in .NET
framework to connect the frontend to the backend.

- Developed web pages (using React, JavaScript, Bootstrap
and other UI tools) that allows the user with an admin role
to manage inventory.

- Designed dynamic forms with Formik and Yup validation
for users to add inventory items.


- Collaborated with an agile development team, conducted
daily standups, regular code reviews, and product
development meetings.

positions.title: Program Coordinator
positions.description:
- Collaborated with the Office of Research and other
faculty, staff, students, and external partners to
effectively coordinate coastal resilience programs.

- Utilized WordPress to create webpage content as well as
manage multiple WordPress powered websites.

- Designed, developed, and edited outreach materials and reports. Created content for websites and
social media channels.

- Assisted with managing budgets for resilience programs developed by
the Office of Research.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Web Page, Digital/Multimedia and Information Resources Design
